5052532153094.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red and gold finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red and Gold. Quantity: 20 pack.
Shatter resistant plastic construction provides a safe alternative to traditional glass ornaments for festive decorating.
Attractive glitter finish adds a light-catching, textured detail that enhances the visual appeal of your Christmas display.
Durable red and gold design retains its shape and colour, ensuring long-lasting decorative impact season after season.
Convenient pack of 20 pieces offers ample quantity to coordinate colours and textures across multiple areas of your home.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 20 Christmas decorations

Christmas Tree & Holiday Decor: Complements traditional glass baubles, lights, and garlands on Christmas trees, fireplaces, mantelpieces, stair railings, and windows.

Handmade Gift Toppers & Keepsakes: Attach finished wooden diamond art pendants to holiday present packages, secret Santa gifts, or stocking stuffers for a personalized touch.

Winter Crafting & Relaxation: Ideal stress-relief creative activity during the winter season and holiday gatherings.

PACKAGE CONTENT

6 x Christmas Wooden Ornament Base Plates

EASY DIY STEPS

Open the package and check all tools and drill gems.

Match the symbol codes on the wooden ornament plate with the corresponding diamond color bags.

Apply a small amount of wax mud into the tip of the drill pen.

Pick up each resin gem using the pen and press it onto its matching symbol on the wooden plate.

Natural Wooden Base: Crafted from durable, lightweight natural wood with smooth edges and vibrant printed holiday patterns on both sides.
3D & 5D Multi-Faceted Sparkle: Includes special-shaped resin rhinestones and sparkling gems that capture and reflect light from every angle.
Complete All-In-One Craft Kit: Comes with everything needed to start crafting immediately—6 wooden ornament bases, drill pen, sorting tray, sticky wax mud, hanging cords, and pre-sorted colored resin diamonds.
Pre-Drilled & Ready to Hang: Each wooden ornament features a pre-drilled top hole and includes natural jute twine/ribbons for easy hanging on Christmas trees, wreaths, and window hooks.
Relaxing & Beginner Friendly: Simple follow-by-number design makes this kit ideal for beginners, experienced crafters, family bonding time, and seasonal DIY projects.

5056141057194.sourceDescription:
Add a bright finishing touch to gifts and displays with these 30mm hot pink pull bows. Supplied as a pack of 10, they are designed to shape quickly by pulling the inner ribbon cords, helping you create neat decoration with minimal effort. The compact 3cm size makes them suitable for gift wrapping, hamper styling, florist bouquets, bottles, baskets and party tables. Made from polypropylene plastic, these bows are easy to handle and simple to store until needed. Their vivid hot pink colour suits birthdays, weddings, craft projects, favour tables and seasonal displays where a lively decorative accent is wanted. A practical choice when you need an easy bow that looks tidy on presents and event décor.
Quick to create: pull the inner cords and each bow forms in seconds for neat gift wrapping and display styling.
Bright hot pink finish adds a lively decorative touch to presents, hampers, bottles and floral arrangements.
Compact 30mm / 3cm size is easy to place on gifts, baskets, wedding cars and party table settings.
Pack of 10 provides useful supply for craft projects, favour tables, seasonal décor and repeated use.
Made from polypropylene plastic for easy handling, tidy storage and a clean look across many occasions.
Indoor Use
Not resistant to shattering

5056141065694.baseName: 35cm B/O LED Twig Hanging Star with Warm White Lights, Red and Brown Festive Christmas Decoration
5056141065694.variantName: 35cm B/O LED Twig Hanging Star with Warm White Lights, Red and Brown Festive Christmas Decoration
5056141065694.sourceDescription:
Bring a warm festive finish to your home with this 35cm battery operated LED twig hanging star. Designed in a rustic twig and PVC style, it combines a natural look with decorative seasonal detail to create an eye-catching display for Christmas and other winter celebrations. The star shape is finished in a red and brown colourway and includes warm white LED lights, making it a charming feature for doors, mantelpieces, dining areas or wall displays.

This hanging decoration is decorated with red baubles, red berries, shimmering bronze stars, green foliage and rustic pine cones, helping it add depth and texture to your seasonal styling. The pre-strung design supports quick setup and easy display, while the lightweight construction makes it simple to hang and reposition as needed. It is battery operated and requires 2 x AA batteries, which are not included.

Made from twig and PVC, this decorative star is suitable for indoor festive styling and can be folded away for storage and reused for future seasonal occasions. Its versatile look makes it easy to coordinate with other decorations from the same range, helping you build a cohesive holiday display throughout your home.
Warm white LED lighting adds a cosy festive glow, helping this star decoration stand out in windows, on doors or above a mantelpiece.
Twig and PVC construction gives the decoration a rustic seasonal look while keeping it lightweight and easy to hang indoors.
Decorative details including berries, baubles, stars, foliage and pine cones create a rich textured finish for Christmas styling.
Battery operated design requires 2 x AA batteries, allowing flexible placement without the need for a nearby plug socket.
Pre-strung and easy to store, this hanging star can be folded away after the season and reused for future celebrations.
Indoor Use
Not resistant to shattering

8956086439994.sourceDescription:
The 122 cm white faux fur skirt with gold sequin snowflakes, for a tree big enough to need covering properly. Double layered, so it hangs with some weight and does not show the floor through it.

The top is a dense faux fur, the underside a non-woven fabric that stops needles and sap. Gold snowflakes are stitched across the surface in a curve, and the sequins pick up warm bulbs. Hidden hook-and-loop fastening at the opening means it fits round the stand in one movement. At 122 cm it suits trees of roughly 6 to 7 ft and leaves a good ring of floor for presents. Hand wash cold, air dry, brush the pile.

After Christmas it works as a throw rug at the end of a bed.

Material: Faux fur with non-woven backing
122 cm white faux fur with gold sequin snowflakes
Double layer with weight, no floor showing through
Hidden hook-and-loop fastening round the opening
Fits 6 to 7 ft trees with room for presents
Hand wash cold, air dry, doubles as a small rug

5037204458394.sourceDescription:
Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Paper. Product measurements: length 6.8 cm, width 0.1 cm, height 4.5 cm. Quantity: 50 pack.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal character to your tree display.
Comes in a convenient 50-pack, providing plenty of ornaments for full coverage and coordination.
Crafted from paper material, offering a lightweight and traditional finish for classic holiday styling.
Versatile hanging design allows easy placement on branches to create a focal point or fill gaps.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 50 pack of paper ornaments

Christmas Tree Skirt
This Christmas tree skirt adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Plush Fabric and Faux Fur. Stated size: 90 cm; 36 inch. Product weight: 0.26 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Plush fabric and faux fur construction for a soft, festive finish.
Generous 90 cm diameter size fits most standard Christmas trees.
Decorative tree base cover adds a polished focal point to your display.
Lightweight design at just 0.26 kg for easy handling and storage.
For Indoor Use

8941467526394.sourceDescription:
Each bow is made from velvet ribbon with a soft, smooth pile that feels warm to the touch and holds its shape once tied. The deep green shade sits well with traditional Christmas schemes, and the matte velvet picks up tree lights without looking shiny or synthetic. Each bow measures approximately 5 x 10 in (13 x 26 cm), and the ribbon itself is 1 in wide.

The set contains 12 bows, enough to dress a full tree, a pair of wreaths and a garland in one go. At this size the bow reads clearly from across a room, so branches look properly finished rather than sparsely decorated, and a handful left over will happily fill gaps near the top of the tree.

Tie them onto Christmas tree branches, front door wreaths, garlands and mantelpieces, or use them to finish stair rails, window frames, fence posts and fireplace surrounds. Loop the ribbon tails around a rail or hook and knot at the back, then fan the loops out so the velvet sits flat. They suit parties, weddings, engagements, picnics and St Patrick's Day displays just as well.

Because the bows arrive ready made, they also work as crafting supplies. Add them to gift wrap, hampers and handmade decorations, or pass a set on to friends who enjoy DIY projects. Between seasons, store them flat in a dry box away from direct sun so the pile stays soft and the colour holds.

Transform your holiday display this year with one of our elegant Christmas Tree Square Skirts, the perfect finishing touch to any festive setup. By choosing one of these square skirts, you are investing in a product that not only beautifies your tree in the nicest possible way but also simplifies your holiday decorating. 5096825936094.sourceDescription:
Christmas Garland
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Dimensions: 180 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive hanging decoration with decorative detail design to enhance your Christmas display.
Measures 180 cm in length, providing a substantial presence for indoor holiday arrangements.
Designed specifically for Christmas at home, adding a traditional festive touch to any room.
Comes as a single piece, ready to hang and coordinate with other seasonal accessories.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use
Included: 1x Christmas Garland

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its white finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details

Lightweight construction ensures easy handling, moving, and convenient storage in bags or cupboards.

WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE THAT HOLDS ITS NEEDLES: Excellent needle retention helps the Nordmann Fir stay fresh-looking throughout the festive period, reducing the amount of fallen foliage as the weeks go by. Strong branches also provide good support for decorations.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: After Christmas, move the tree back outside so it can continue growing in cooler conditions. As it develops, the evergreen foliage can also provide year-round interest among other evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE FOR FLEXIBLE DISPLAY: Growing in a container means the Nordmann Fir can be moved to different positions as needed, making it easier to manage where the tree is placed. This also makes it possible to grow a Christmas tree without committing immediately to planting it permanently in the ground.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.

5059442001194.sourceDescription:
The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.

TRADITIONAL LOOK AND FEEL - The classic Christmas tree look, with dark green foliage and firm, slightly prickly needles that are ideal for hanging decorations
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.
